data.exact_reserve_text: Claims incurred during the year, net of reinsurance, include adverse prior year development of GBP 8.7m (2016: GBP 0.7m favourable development).
data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding were GBP 111.9m at 1 Jan 2017 and closed at GBP 160.4m at 31 Dec 2017. The report discloses an adverse prior-year development (net of reinsurance) of GBP 8.7m in 2017. Management attribute increases in technical provisions to adverse catastrophe experience during the year and general claims inflationary pressure. The largest exposures by outstanding liability at year end were third party liability, reinsurance acceptances and fire & other property damage.
raw_causal_phrases: adverse catastrophe experience in the year
adverse prior year development of GBP 8.7m (2016: GBP 0.7m favourable development)
The most significant risks arise from climate changes, natural disasters and terrorist activities
inflation risk is mitigated by taking expected inflation into account when estimating insurance contract liabilities
increase is driven by the adverse catastrophe experience and the provision of IBNR on the live business from additional premium

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Statement of Financial Position (Technical provisions, Claims outstanding) 2016 comparative column. No explicit GROSS prior-year development figure was found in the movement notes; the report explicitly states a net adverse prior year development of GBP 8.7m and that net amount has been used as a fallback (NET of reinsurance - no gross figure available). The gross claims development triangle is present (page 38) but some detailed cell values were not legible enough to extract reliably; therefore triangle development rows were not fully transcribed. Per-LOB movement amounts are not published; lob_movements amounts are closing gross outstanding liabilities by LOB (page 36) converted to millions and directions are inferred from the overall adverse movement but are not quantified as prior-year-specific movements.

_claims_triangle.notes: A gross claims development table is present on page 38, but individual development-period cells could not be extracted reliably from the provided images; therefore development rows are left empty here. The report does include a net statement of prior year development (net adverse GBP 8.7m) which was used as a fallback.
